changeSet.author: mitzelose@unisystems.gr
changeSet.sql: UPDATE request_task AS target SET payload = source.payload FROM request_task AS source WHERE target.request_id = source.request_id AND target.type = 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE_WAIT_FOR_REVIEW' AND target.payload IS NULL AND source.type = 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE_APPLICATION_REVIEW' AND source.payload IS NOT NULL AND target.request_id IN ( SELECT id FROM request WHERE type = 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE' AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS');

rollback.sql: UPDATE request_task SET payload = NULL WHERE type = 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE_WAIT_FOR_REVIEW' AND request_id IN ( SELECT source.request_id FROM request_task source WHERE source.type = 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE_APPLICATION_REVIEW' ) AND request_id IN ( SELECT id FROM request WHERE type = 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE' AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS' );
